headline_marked: Bangladesh secures [[first-ever Test win in Australia]] with 9-wicket victory
headline: Bangladesh secures first-ever Test win in Australia with 9-wicket victory
summary: The Tigers thrashed Australia in Darwin inside four days, marking a historic milestone and their second-ever win against the formidable opponents.
details: Bangladesh achieved a historic nine-wicket victory over Australia in Darwin, marking their first-ever Test win on Australian soil. The match concluded inside four days, signaling what many call the biggest achievement in the country's Test history.

Fast bowler Hasan Mahmud set the stage with a career-best 6-55, bowling out Australia for 198 on the opening day. The momentum continued as the batters took charge, scoring over 400 in the first innings.
Tanzid Hasan scored his maiden Test century, while captain Najmul Hossain Shanto and all-rounder Mehidy Hasan Miraz provided crucial contributions to secure the lead.
The victory is particularly striking as Bangladesh had been bowled out for just 54 in a warm-up match against a Cricket Australia XI only days prior.
BCB president Tamim Iqbal described the performance as extraordinary, noting that the win comes after 23 years of trying to conquer Australian conditions.
Prime Minister Tarique Rahman congratulated the team via a video call, while former players and fans hailed the win as a turning point for Bangladesh's cricketing ambitions.
caption:
History made in Darwin! 🇧🇩
Bangladesh secures its first-ever Test win on Australian soil with a dominant 9-wicket victory.

Bangladesh achieved a historic nine-wicket victory over Australia in Darwin, marking their first-ever Test win on Australian soil. The match concluded inside four days, signaling what many call the biggest achievement in the country's Test history.

Fast bowler Hasan Mahmud set the stage with a career-best 6-55, bowling out Australia for 198 on the opening day. The momentum continued as the batters took charge, scoring over 400 in the first innings.

Tanzid Hasan scored his maiden Test century, while captain Najmul Hossain Shanto and all-rounder Mehidy Hasan Miraz provided crucial contributions to secure the lead.

The victory is particularly striking as Bangladesh had been bowled out for just 54 in a warm-up match against a Cricket Australia XI only days prior.

BCB president Tamim Iqbal described the performance as extraordinary, noting that the win comes after 23 years of trying to conquer Australian conditions.

Prime Minister Tarique Rahman congratulated the team via a video call, while former players and fans hailed the win as a turning point for Bangladesh's cricketing ambitions.

headline_marked: BRTC to launch [[pink buses operated by women]] for female passengers
headline: BRTC to launch pink buses operated by women for female passengers
summary: The Bangladesh Road Transport Corporation is introducing a new service featuring women drivers and conductors exclusively for women.
details: The Bangladesh Road Transport Corporation (BRTC) is rolling out a new fleet of pink buses specifically for female passengers. These buses will be operated entirely by women drivers and conductors.
The service is scheduled to be inaugurated on Tuesday at 10:00 am at the BRTC Dhaka Truck Depot in Tejgaon.
The inauguration program will be attended by Road Transport and Bridges, Railways, and Shipping Minister Shaikh Rabiul Alam as the chief guest.
Other key attendees include State Minister for Railways and Road Transport and Highways Habibur Rashid, and Dr Mohammad Ziaul Haque, secretary of the Road Transport and Highways Division.
BRTC Chairman Abdul Latif Molla will chair the event.
According to a BRTC press release, this initiative is part of the government's effort to implement commitments made in its election manifesto.
caption:
Women drivers, women conductors, and women passengers. BRTC is launching a dedicated pink bus service in Dhaka!

The Bangladesh Road Transport Corporation (BRTC) is rolling out a new fleet of pink buses specifically for female passengers. These buses will be operated entirely by women drivers and conductors.

The service is scheduled to be inaugurated on Tuesday at 10:00 am at the BRTC Dhaka Truck Depot in Tejgaon.

The inauguration program will be attended by Road Transport and Bridges, Railways, and Shipping Minister Shaikh Rabiul Alam as the chief guest.

Other key attendees include State Minister for Railways and Road Transport and Highways Habibur Rashid, and Dr Mohammad Ziaul Haque, secretary of the Road Transport and Highways Division.

BRTC Chairman Abdul Latif Molla will chair the event.

According to a BRTC press release, this initiative is part of the government's effort to implement commitments made in its election manifesto.
